concept.title: Customize Profiling Attribute
concept.shortdesc: Customize Profiling Attribute feature in DITA is a critical element for technical writers in taxonomy creation.

conbody.note: This is an advanced feature and requires specialization with respect to creating a new profiling attribute.
conbody.p: Beginners can limit themselves to the customization of existing profiling attributes.
Only advanced users can create new profiling attributes and is particularly useful for adoption of DITA in a production enviornment.
